source: Ray job API (status, start/end) and each job's console log (steps reached; curves in results/v3/loss_curves/)

shared_recipe.model: X-VLA 0.9B (LeRobot), base = lerobot/xvla-base widened to a 32-d action / 20-d state head, processor domain_id 20 (an untrained soft-prompt slot, see results/v3/domain_slots/)
shared_recipe.loss: REL-only: MSE on action dims 0:20 (CART20, 16 x 50.05 ms); dims 20:32 hard-zeroed at input and output
shared_recipe.optimizer: bitsandbytes AdamW8bit, policy lr 1e-4 (VLM group x0.1 = 1e-5, the value LeRobot prints), wd 1e-4, warmup 1k, cosine to 2.5e-6 at steps = decay
shared_recipe.fine_tuning_init: fresh optimizer and scheduler; robot dataset statistics

R384.kind: R312c + 72 further reBot teleoperation episodes (21 far-layout, 51 earlier-phase)

datasets.EGO_v2b_ROBOT100: EGO_v2b with every wrist frame re-rendered as a pinhole robot-like view
datasets.EGO_v2b_MIX70: EGO_v2b with 70 % of wrist frames re-rendered

comparability.A60_vs_B60: valid: same data, schedule, seed and recipe; training loss only; one seed per arm
comparability.A300_vs_B300: NOT a transfer comparison: different robot datasets (R384 vs R312c)
comparability.COTRAIN_loss: not comparable to A/B: half of every batch is ego data
